Title: Chain an existing OPQMatrix with a new IVFPQ index
Description: # Summary

<!-- Facebook has a bounty program for the safe disclosure of security bugs. In
those cases, please go through the process outlined on that page and do not
file a public issue. -->

I have trained an IVFOPQ index and I want to migrate the OPQMatrix to the top of a new(untrained) IVFPQ index. Here is my code:
```
import faiss

old = faiss.index_factory(128, "OPQ16,IVF4,PQ16")   # suppose it is already trained, the opqmatrix is not empty
new = faiss.index_factory(128, "IVF4,PQ16")   # a new index that I want to prepend an OPQMatrix to

vector_transform = faiss.downcast_VectorTransform(old.chain.at(0))
old_opq_matrix = vector_transform.A
old_opq_array = faiss.vector_to_array(old_opq_matrix)

new_opq_matrix = faiss.OPQMatrix(vector_transform.d_in, 1, vector_transform.d_out)
faiss.copy_array_to_vector(old_opq_array, new_opq_matrix.A)
new_index = faiss.IndexPreTransform(new_opq_matrix, new)
```
I don't think it's a good idea that we should copy the vector to a new array then copy them back. Is there a easier way to do this? I just need to chain the **old** VectorTransform and a **new** IVFPQ. 

I tried the following but none of them worked (throwing segmentation error when adding embeddings to the new index):
```
new_index = faiss.IndexPreTransform(old.chain.at(0), new)
new_index = faiss.IndexPreTransform(faiss.downcast_VectorTransform(old.chain.at(0)), new)
```
